faq: Does eBay allow custom HTML in listings?
eBay allows simple HTML and CSS, but blocks scripts, active content and external links in descriptions. We build the template to those limits so that your listing is not removed for a policy reason.
Will it work with the eBay app?

Yes, we test on a phone screen and keep the layout single-column, with short text blocks and images that scale. Some eBay mobile views simplify a description, so we make sure key facts also sit in item specifics.
Can I edit the template myself later?
Yes. We mark the parts you change, like the item name and photos, with clear labels, and send a short guide. If you prefer, we can update the file for you through the add-ons.
Will you add a store logo or banner?
Yes, using files you send, or a simple text logo if you have none. We do not use brand names or images you do not own or have rights to.
desc:
Well-made eBay listing templates give every description a clean, branded layout that reads easily on a phone. Ecom Swift LLC designs templates that follow eBay's rules, tests them on mobile and desktop and loads them into your listings.

## What is an eBay listing template?

An eBay listing template is a reusable layout for the description area of a listing. It holds the fixed parts that repeat from item to item, such as your logo, a short note about you, shipping and returns, and a contact line, and leaves clear spaces for what changes: the item's own details.

A good template saves time and makes your listings look like they come from one business. A poor one is a mess of colors and wide tables that falls apart on a small screen.

## Why phone readers change how templates must be built

Most eBay browsing happens on phones, and the eBay app shows descriptions in a narrow column. A template made for a wide desktop page can force pinching, sideways scrolling or tiny text. A buyer who cannot read the key facts quickly may move on to the next result.

Phone-first design means short blocks, large readable text, strong contrast and simple stacking. Layout tricks that depend on fixed widths are avoided. It also means checking the template on real devices, because a preview on one screen rarely tells the whole story.

## How a template helps your listings sell

A template answers the same buyer questions in the same place every time. Shipping, returns and contact details sit where people expect them, so fewer messages arrive asking things the listing already says. A consistent look also tells a buyer that a real business stands behind the item.

A template does not replace good item details. It frames them. Buyers still need accurate titles, item specifics and photos, and the template simply keeps the presentation tidy so those facts are easy to find.

## What a good eBay template includes

- Your logo and brand colors applied with restraint.
- Short sections for item facts, what is included and condition.
- Clear shipping and returns blocks that match your business policies.
- A readable font size and strong contrast on a small screen.
- A layout that stacks cleanly into one column on phones.
- A contact or message line that points buyers to eBay's own messaging.
- Only code that eBay allows, with no scripts and no outside links.
- Image sizes that load quickly on mobile data.
- Placeholder text so you know exactly what to replace for each item.

## What we do

We collect your logo, colors and any wording you already use. We then design the layout, build it with allowed code only and test it on a phone and a desktop screen. You get the template ready to paste into the description field or to load into your listings.

The Basic package covers one template. The Standard package adds a second layout, sections for specifications and shipping, a bulk-ready file and application to some of your listings. The Premium package provides several layouts, a store-style header banner, wider application across your range and a short style guide so new listings stay consistent.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep the template short so the item itself stays the focus.
- Use no more than two fonts and a small set of colors.
- Test it on your own phone before applying it widely.
- Keep the shipping and returns text identical to your policies.
- Save a plain copy of each description before you apply a template.

**Avoid:**
- Large banners that push the item details far down the page.
- Animations, pop-ups, scripts or links to other websites.
- Wide tables and fixed-width blocks.
- Light grey text on a white background.
- Repeating promotional text that makes every listing look the same.

## Who this is for

This service suits a seller whose listings look different from one item to the next. It suits a small brand that wants eBay to match its own site, and a seller who has a template that looks fine on a laptop but reads badly in the app.

## What we need from you

Send your logo, brand colors and any text you want in the fixed sections, along with a few example listings. Tell us which product types you sell, so the layouts fit them. We never ask for your password. If we apply templates to live listings, we do it through the access eBay allows for your account.
